title: P0 forecast magnitude calibration decision
decision: The leakage-safe scale calibration improves MAPE slightly versus the raw incumbent but remains worse than the previous-close baseline.
Directional accuracy falls from 47.78% to 41.11%, and forecast magnitude becomes even more compressed (magnitude ratio 0.0495 to 0.0240).
No calibration or challenger is justified for production.

p0_assessment.blocking_requirement: A challenger must beat both incumbent and previous-close baseline on untouched chronological folds and the locked prospective cohort, with acceptable directional accuracy, signed bias, magnitude and governance checks.

next_step: Investigate whether the available features contain a stable predictive signal before attempting further post-hoc magnitude scaling; do not amplify forecasts solely to match realized volatility.
